Class AdvancedSearchFieldService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AdvancedSearchFieldService
@Service public class AdvancedSearchFieldService extends Object
Computes the fields the logged-in user can choose in an advanced search criterion. The validation of a search request and the base data of the search dialog read the same list, so a field that is not offered is also refused.

Offered are the stored user-defined fields of securities the user can see and all indicator columns of the tenant. A user-defined field whose value is only computed for the display of a watchlist and never written to udf_data is not offered, because a search could never find a value of it. A field that holds a link is not offered either, because a link is opened and not searched.
